items.title: Show HN: My Terminal Themes Web App
items.title_cn: 显示HN ：我的终端主题网络应用程序
items.summary: Well, after 15 years of saying "Someday I'll turn this into a web app," I finally did it! I've been maintaining a popular repo of terminal themes at https://github.com/mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes , and it was finally time to build the app with all the features I wanted! So, the next-gen version is live at https://terminalthemes.com ! It currently has over 800 themes, and provides downloads for close to 40 different formats (iTerm, Ghostty, Windows, and many more) It's free for everyone. An ac
items.summary_cn: 好吧，经过15年的说“总有一天我会把它变成一个网络应用程序” ，我终于做到了！我一直在https://github.com/mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes上维护一个流行的终端主题存储库，现在终于是时候构建具有我想要的所有功能的应用程序了！因此，新一代版本已在https://terminalthemes.com上线！它目前有800多个主题，并提供近40种不同格式（ iTerm、Ghostty、Windows等）的下载。每个人都可以免费使用。
items.comment: GitHub 上的新玩具，先 fork 再说，说不定哪天就成神器了。
